answer_2.quote: Pure GPT-3.5 (without our NLI module) only hits rare ground truth... exact-match F1 scores are unsatisfactory; ... The acceptance rate of the NLI-selected relations in the test set is 71.3% ... recall and precision are reported for the generated triples.

answer_4.quote: For the Re-DocRED test set, after acquiring distant relation triples, each distant triple will be conducted through human verification. Two annotators are asked to answer whether the relation triples can be inferred according to the provided documents. A third annotator will resolve the conflicting annotations. Specifically, we use Mechanical Turk for human annotations.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators are asked to determine whether each generated relation triple can be inferred from the document.
